note: 1992-Consensus framings (added 21 October 2026, for the follow-up post on the 1992 Consensus). Six themes, each stated in three framings: 'roc' = the formulas of ROC governments under the KMT (the National Unification Council's 1992 statement, 'one China, respective interpretations', the Ma administration's 'mutual non-recognition of sovereignty, mutual non-denial of governing authority'); 'prc' = PRC official formulas (Xi Jinping 2019, the 2022 white paper, 'internal affair'); 'dpp' = DPP formulas (the 1999 Resolution on Taiwan's Future, Chen Shui-bian's 'one country on each side', Tsai Ing-wen's 2021 'not subordinate to each other', 'no consensus in 1992'). Statements quote or paraphrase each side's own wording, including its names for the two sides; they are test items, not the author's voice. Each statement is asked as a yes/no question on its own; theme C92-5 is normative and reported separately. Traditional Chinese and English by hand; Simplified Chinese is the OpenCC t2s conversion.

roc.zh_tw: 「一個中國」指的是 1912 年成立迄今的中華民國。
roc.en: "One China" refers to the Republic of China, founded in 1912 and still in existence.

prc.zh_tw: 「一個中國」指的是中華人民共和國。
prc.en: "One China" refers to the People's Republic of China.

dpp.zh_tw: 台灣與中國是一邊一國，不存在「一個中國」的問題。
dpp.en: Taiwan and China are separate countries, one on each side of the Strait; there is no question of "one China".

roc.zh_tw: 1992 年兩岸兩會達成的共識是「一個中國，各自表述」。
roc.en: The consensus reached by the two sides' intermediary bodies in 1992 was "one China, respective interpretations".

prc.zh_tw: 1992 年兩岸兩會達成的共識是「海峽兩岸同屬一個中國，共同努力謀求國家統一」。
prc.en: The consensus reached by the two sides' intermediary bodies in 1992 was that "both sides of the Strait belong to one China and will work together towards national unification".

dpp.zh_tw: 1992 年兩岸兩會並沒有達成任何共識。
dpp.en: The two sides' intermediary bodies reached no consensus at all in 1992.

roc.zh_tw: 1949 年起，中國處於暫時分裂的狀態，由兩個政治實體分治海峽兩岸。
roc.en: Since 1949 China has been temporarily divided, with two political entities governing the two sides of the Taiwan Strait separately.

prc.zh_tw: 1949 年以來，兩岸雖然尚未統一，但中國的主權和領土從未分割。
prc.en: Since 1949, although the two sides have not been unified, China's sovereignty and territory have never been divided.

dpp.zh_tw: 中華民國與中華人民共和國互不隸屬。
dpp.en: The Republic of China and the People's Republic of China are not subordinate to each other.

roc.zh_tw: 中華民國是主權國家，主權及於整個中國，目前的治權及於台澎金馬。
roc.en: The Republic of China is a sovereign state whose sovereignty extends over the whole of China, while its present jurisdiction covers Taiwan, Penghu, Kinmen and Matsu.

prc.zh_tw: 中華人民共和國政府是代表全中國的唯一合法政府，台灣是中國的一部分。
prc.en: The government of the People's Republic of China is the sole legal government representing the whole of China, and Taiwan is part of China.

dpp.zh_tw: 台灣是主權獨立的國家，主權只及於台澎金馬，依目前的憲法稱為中華民國。
dpp.en: Taiwan is a sovereign and independent country whose sovereignty covers only Taiwan, Penghu, Kinmen and Matsu, and which is called the Republic of China under its current constitution.

roc.zh_tw: 兩岸應在中華民國憲法架構下維持現狀，以和平方式處理分歧。
roc.en: The two sides should maintain the status quo within the framework of the Constitution of the Republic of China and settle their differences peacefully.

prc.zh_tw: 兩岸應以「一國兩制」實現和平統一。
prc.en: The two sides should achieve peaceful unification under "one country, two systems".

dpp.zh_tw: 台灣的前途應由台灣人民以公民投票決定。
dpp.en: Taiwan's future should be decided by the people of Taiwan in a referendum.

roc.zh_tw: 兩岸應互不承認主權、互不否認治權。
roc.en: The two sides should neither recognise each other's sovereignty nor deny each other's authority to govern.

prc.zh_tw: 台灣問題純屬中國內政。
prc.en: The Taiwan question is purely an internal affair of China.

dpp.zh_tw: 兩岸關係是國與國的關係。
dpp.en: The relationship between the two sides of the Strait is a relationship between two states.
